Barr-Nunn Application Process
Step 1
Recruiter completes the application for the driver
https://intelliapp2.driverapponline.com/c/barrnunntrans?r=CLASSARECRUITING.COM&release_signature_screen_submit_without_signing=y
How did you hear about us? Please select "C.A.R."
DO NOT enter your name on the application please!
-
Step 2
List the following information in the "Carrier Notes" section:
What run the driver is applying for?
How much and what type of experience the driver has?
Click save and open it again. Then click the green submit button.
Step 3
Send the link for releases to the driver
https://intelliapp2.driverapponline.com/s/barrnunntrans?r=CLASSARECRUITING.COM
Step 4
Driver will be contacted within 24 hours by one of the 4 recruiters. If they haven't reached out, please have the driver call 888-999-7576
Drivers must be fully approved before they will schedule orientation
My Driver is Approvedà Now What?
Drivers have to do their physical and drug screens prior to coming to orientation ù the latest they allow that is Thursday morning prior to the following Monday's class
BN recruiters will set up orientation with the driver
Additional Notes
To get faster answers, always speak with your driver before asking for an update. You should be communicating what the driver is currently experiencing.
Bad Example: Can I get an update on this driver?
Good Example: This driver has signed releases but says they have not heard from anyone in over 24 hours. Can we have Barr-Nunn reach out to the driver?
You want to make sure you're communicating an update at least every 24 hours to keep the driver engaged and moving through the process.
The business day before orientation, you want to make sure your driver calls in to Barr-Nunn to confirm orientation so they're not removed from the schedule.
Weekend Emergency Information
Confirm the driver has received their orientation information by 5:00 p.m. EST on Fridays
Make sure the driver is checking their spam in their email (communications go to whatever email they or you put on their application)
In the event of an emergency over the weekend, please have the driver call 515-999-2525
Make sure the driver leaves a message and their contact information

Swift Application Process
Step 1
Recruiter completes the partial application using the link below
https://intelliapp2.driverapponline.com/c/swiftcompthird
Select "Matt Hutto" as recruiter from their drop down menu
Need proof of any self employment upfront i.e. Lyft, Uber, self employed
Step 2
Send the driver the link below to finish the application
https://intelliapp2.driverapponline.com/c/swiftcomp?r=classa
Select "Matt Hutto" as recruiter from their drop down menu
Step 3
Enter driver into Driver Management and list the following information in the "Carrier Notes" section:
Home time - (weekly, daily, weekends etc)
Schedule - (what exact schedule was sold, i.e. M-F 8AM starts, 12+ hour shifts.)
Account - (Walmart Temple etc)
Pay - (what exact CPM or hourly pay was quoted etc) 13.05/hr + 18.16 per load avg 1500+ a week.
App confirmation number
Driver's SSN
You will have to click save and reopen it. Once you reopen it, click the green submit button.
Any documents (CDL, school certificate, birth certificate, tax docs, passports, etc.) must come directly from the driver and be sent directly to the Swift admin or Matt Hutto.
Orientation Locations Map: https://www.google.com/maps/d/edit?mid=1IxsNmwr_pwdPpKzn-tAwQNZREuZURS3H&usp=sharing
You will receive an email with the Swift admin your app is assigned to after submitting the driver into Driver Management. If the driver has not filled out the full 10-year app for Swift, that includes the release signature pages at the end, you will get an email from the admin that says ALS. ALS means app link sent. Advise your driver to check their email (including their spam folder) and send you the confirmation # when itÆs complete. If you receive an email that says RC requested, they are requesting ownership of the application for you prior to working the file to ensure you get credit.
Swift apps will be assigned to one of the following: David L, Joey, Devan, David C., Shane Sr, Shane Jr, Kevin Igle or Brian Foss.
Step 4
Please have the driver send a copy (front & back) of the driver's CDL to the Swift admin they are assigned to.
Follow Up
Whoever your app is assigned to will get the email letting Swift know that there is an application that has been submitted.
Whoever your app is assigned to will then go into Tenstreet and search for the app. If they see it then they will request RC. They will not notify you about any of this part of the process.
Once the driver is under Class A, whoever your app is assigned to will then request the full app from the driver via their email.
After they have the full app, whoever your app is assigned to will notify you via email of the app and processor assigned to the driver's app.
If there are any status changes or anything then they will reach out to you.
If you have any questions or need an update on your driver please email whoever your app is assigned to.
My Driver Is Approved... What Now?
Fridays & Tuesdays David L, Joey, Devan, Shane Sr, David C, Shane Jr or Brian will reach out to confirm orientation on Wednesday and give them travel/hotel plans on Fridays.
Steps You and the Driver Can Expect With Swift:
Recruiter completes a partial application (step 1)
Driver completes a full application (step 2)
Recruiter notifies the admin that the full application is complete by providing the confirmation #
Once the app is received, the admin will call the driver and start running reports
Answer SwiftÆs qualifying questions with the admin
Driver will have to provide accident/incident reports if applicable
Driver will need to complete Clearinghouse consent request
Complete any required sleep study screening if flagged
Complete pre-employment physical
Complete pre-employment drug testing (hair test)
Pass SwiftÆs English assessment (written + verbal)
Complete TraCorp training videos and assigned tasks
Pass DQP safety/medical review
Review & sign final packet
Attend DQP (Driver Qualification Process) in person at terminal
Wait for OK-to-Code status
Wait for ôHiredö status after code entry (usually happens once the driver receives their driver code û pending drug tests can delay this part)
Glossary of Terms
AA: Pending Adverse Action (driver is rejected)
ALS: App Link Sent (driver needs to complete the app and send you the confirmation #)
AM: Account Manager
BQA: Better qualified applicants (driver is rejected)
DQP (Driver Qualification Process): Orientation
First Seat / Experienced: CDL A holder with more than 6 months of recent experience.
RC: Recruiter Change - getting app ownership from Swift to Class A so you get credit
Student: Non CDL A holder.
Trainee: CDL A holder with less than 6 months of recent experience.
